epv_definition: Observed net contribution margin per unique qualified visitor, calculated only from verified external settled orders that are correctly attributed and fulfilled, after refunds, processor/network fees, direct fulfillment costs, and provider costs.
policy_rules: Unknown EPV is not zero and is not a number to be optimised; it is a HOLD.
A simulation, generated signal, synthetic fossil hash or claimed signals-per-second benchmark cannot satisfy a scale gate.
Each order counted must have independent external buyer evidence, settlement evidence, exact offer attribution, fulfillment completion, and a retrievable non-empty payload proof hash.
An empty-payload SHA-256 digest is explicitly rejected as delivery proof.
A `SETTLED` row is not equivalent to `FULFILLED`, and a paid post is not marked COMPLETED until delivery proof exists.
This module only recommends a target. It does not create, terminate, or resize workers.
prerequisites_for_any_recommendation: upstream provider-backed settlement reconciliation marks its evidence bundle VERIFIED and signed
at least three distinct independent external buyers settled within the measured seven-day window
all included orders are correctly attributed and fulfilled
positive aggregate contribution margin after refunds, fees and fulfillment/provider costs
unique qualified-visitor denominator and window are observed
quota and capacity guardrails are PASS
